newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco unleaded diffs ease, prices steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco unleaded diffs ease, prices steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline differentials eased on Wednesday, offsetting higher NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures from a day earlier to leave prices steady in early spot market trade, traders said.
Draws in unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel in the weekly American Petroleum Institite stocks estimates were lending some support to spot prices in the Chicago and Group Three markets, traders said.
Midwest refineries reported 28.1 million barrels of distillate inventories on hand in the PADD 2 region, a 912,000 barrel draw on the week, API said late Tuesday.
Gasoline stocks on hand at Midwest refineries were pegged at 53.12 million barrels, down 1.46 million barrels on the week, API said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline for April deliveries was bid 1.0 cent a gallon under NYMEX May unleaded, with Group Three unleaded bid 2.50 cents a gallon under the print.
Traders expected the unleaded differential to continue drawing closer and eventually trade at a premium to the print in a normal seasonal shift in demand ahead of the summer driving season.
Low sulphur diesel for April deliveries remained 4.50/4.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX May heating oil in Chicago and 5.0/5.25 cents over in Group Three, traders said.
